context: Evaluates correct configuration of Uppy for single-file image upload with restrictions. Focuses on whether the correct Uppy constructor options (autoProceed, restrictions) and plugin configurations (Dashboard inline/dark, XHRUpload fieldName) are applied.

checklist.name: autoProceed enabled
checklist.description: The Uppy instance is created with autoProceed: true so uploads start immediately without user action.

checklist.name: File type restrictions
checklist.description: restrictions.allowedFileTypes is set to ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/tiff', 'image/webp'] or equivalent.

checklist.name: Max file size restriction
checklist.description: restrictions.maxFileSize is set to 10485760 (10 * 1024 * 1024 bytes) or equivalent 10MB value.

checklist.name: Dashboard inline + dark theme
checklist.description: The Dashboard plugin is added via uppy.use(Dashboard, {...}) with inline: true and theme: 'dark'.

checklist.name: Dashboard target container
checklist.description: The Dashboard target is set to the container DOM element (e.g., via a ref), not a string selector.

checklist.name: XHRUpload fieldName
checklist.description: XHRUpload is configured with fieldName: 'files[]' matching the server's expected field name.
